content.short: Aspire is a Singapore business finance platform with multi-currency accounts, corporate cards, expenses and payroll.
content.description: Aspire, founded in 2018 and based in Singapore, is an all-in-one finance platform for startups and small and mid-sized businesses across Southeast Asia and beyond. From one account, companies get multi-currency business accounts, corporate and virtual cards with cashback, accounts payable and expense management, foreign exchange, yield on idle cash and payroll, tied to accounting integrations. Businesses use Aspire to collect payments in several currencies, pay staff and vendors abroad, control team spending and reconcile transactions. It is used by more than 50,000 businesses across markets including Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the US.
content.meta: Aspire offers business accounts, corporate cards, expenses and payroll for APAC companies. Discover Aspire and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
